concerns.text: Task T008 (Implement resource monitoring) references FR-005, but the description lacks specifics on *how* resource limits will be enforced. This needs clarification to ensure implementability.

Task T012 (Implement data ingestion) mentions Zenodo DOI fallback, but doesn't explicitly state how the system handles a *second* failed attempt after both DOIs are exhausted. This is covered in spec FR-001 and needs to be addressed.
Task T014 (Implement retention rate logging) references FR-001, but doesn't specify *where* the cleaned data will be saved beyond 'data/processed/cleaned_mg.csv'. This needs to be explicit.

Task T015 (Implement error handling) references FR-001, but the description is vague about what constitutes 'DATA_UNAVAILABLE' – a clear definition or constant is needed for consistent implementation.
Task T024 (Save model artifacts) references SC-001, but doesn’t specify *what* metrics will be saved alongside the model. The spec lists R², MAE; this needs to be explicitly stated in the task.

Task T033 (Implement correlation calculation) references FR-009, but doesn't specify *which* predictors will be used for the correlation analysis. This needs to be clarified based on the model features.

Task T034 (Implement FDR correction) references FR-008, but doesn't mention the alpha level used for the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. The spec states α ≤ 0.05; this should be included in the task description.
Task T036 (Implement bootstrapping) references SC-002, but doesn't specify the number of resamples to use for calculating confidence intervals. This needs a defined value or range.

Task T048 is redundant and contradicts existing documentation; it asks to implement a feature that has already been deemed unnecessary, and its inclusion violates principle of least astonishment. Delete this task.
